payload.claim: The sentence "a parameterless `def` of a name with one leading underscore, an indented `pass`, an indented one-line docstring, and a comment whose pattern holds a quantifier's braces." runs 26 words, over CLAUDE.md's stated limit for new prose ("New Markdown and new comments take no ... sentence over 25 words"). This text is a bare string-literal statement following `INERT_PATTERNS = (...)`, not the first statement of a module, function or class, so `ast.get_docstring` never sees it and `.saffron/gates/prose.py`'s `_documented()` never selects it for checking — it is blanked out of the text the `prose` gate reads entirely. The convention still applies to new comment-like text even where the gate's AST-based detection cannot reach it.
